subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `captionedFinalText` as a public channel capability and make Telegram final-mode TTS use captioned voice delivery by default when the capability is present?
rationale: The code appears to fix the bug at the right dispatch boundary, but it expands the plugin SDK contract and changes default Telegram delivery semantics in a compatibility-sensitive message path.

options.title: Accept after proof
options.body: Require current-head Telegram proof for always, tagged directive-only, and media-preservation paths, then accept the public capability/default behavior.

options.title: Keep it Telegram-internal
options.body: Remove the public SDK/docs surface and land only a narrower Telegram-owned implementation if maintainers do not want this capability yet.

options.title: Pause for delivery-mode UX
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether separate text-plus-voice should be configurable before changing the final-mode default.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof
recommendation.body: Require current-head Telegram proof for always, tagged directive-only, and media-preservation paths, then accept the public capability/default behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history touches the central dispatch and channel capability files, and this choice sits at the dispatch/channel capability boundary.
